```{r}
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)

if (exists("con") && dbIsValid(con)) dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

source(here::here("R", "utils.R"))
con <- connect_nflverse(read_only = TRUE)
```

# 1. Checks for script files 

## Checks for: 04_views.R

```{r}
# ## To confirm the view exists

dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT view_name FROM duckdb_views() WHERE NOT internal ORDER BY view_name")
```



## Checks for: 05_comments.R

```{r}

# # Note/optional: To read them back
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT table_name, comment FROM duckdb_tables() WHERE comment IS NOT NULL;")
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT table_name, column_name, comment FROM duckdb_columns() WHERE comment IS NOT NULL;")
# Only two tables show up under duckdb_tables() because the view comment (on ngs_passing_weekly) lives under duckdb_views()
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT view_name, comment FROM duckdb_views() WHERE comment IS NOT NULL")

```

## Checks for: 06_checks.R

```{r}
# Checking
# This is also a check that your view works. week should have a min of 1 here.
# The base ngs_passing table had a min of 0, and the ngs_passing_season view should show 0 for both min and max.
res <- dbGetQuery(con, "SUMMARIZE ngs_passing_weekly")
res[res$column_name %in% c("season", "week"), c("column_name", "min", "max", "null_percentage")]

res2 <- dbGetQuery(con, "SUMMARIZE ngs_passing_season")
res2[res$column_name %in% c("season", "week"), c("column_name", "min", "max", "null_percentage")]

# Meta logs created in 01 build and 02 updates
res3 <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM meta_load_log;")
res3

```




# 2. Checking on details within the database 

Can do ...

```{sql connection=con}

SELECT version()
```





```{sql}
#| connection: con
SELECT season, COUNT(*) AS n_plays, COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS n_games
FROM nflverse_pbp
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season;
```

Verify that zero rows returned means game_id, play_id is unique

```{sql connection=con}

SELECT game_id, play_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM nflverse_pbp
GROUP BY game_id, play_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

```

Given by Claude: 
```{sql connection=con}

SELECT passer_player_id,
       MAX(passer_player_name) AS passer,
       COUNT(*)                AS pass_plays,
       ROUND(AVG(epa), 3)      AS epa_per_play
FROM nflverse_pbp
WHERE season = 2026
  AND season_type = 'REG'
  AND play_type = 'pass'
  AND epa IS NOT NULL
  AND passer_player_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY passer_player_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
ORDER BY epa_per_play DESC;

```

Trying variations to see what they do.

In SQL single line comments with two consequetive hyphens --
Multi-line or block coments with /* and */

```{sql connection=con}

SELECT passer_player_id,
       MAX(passer_player_name) AS passer, -- FIRST or LAST or MAX
       COUNT(*) AS pass_plays, -- COUNT() also worked
       ROUND(AVG(epa), 3)      AS epa_per_play, -- didn't originally have comma at end, still works
       --ROUND(MAX(epa), 3)      AS epa_max
FROM nflverse_pbp
WHERE season = 2026
  AND season_type = 'REG'
  AND play_type = 'pass'
  AND epa IS NOT NULL -- worked even without all 3 criteria
  AND passer_player_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY passer_player_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
ORDER BY epa_per_play DESC;

```
